itinerary.cal: Same NPS backcountry permit zone and July-September seasonal window as the other Goode Glacier routes.

days.note: PCT south from the Bridge Creek trailhead, up North Fork Bridge Creek (ford required), then off-trail to a camp near the glacier toe/moraine (~6,700 ft), the shared staging camp for Goode's northeast-side routes.
days.title: Approach to high camp
days.objective: Reach camp near the Goode Glacier moraine

days.note: Cross the glacier to the base of the face and climb to the summit (roped low-5th-class climbing similar in character to the adjacent Northeast Buttress), then descend the standard Southwest Couloir back down toward camp. A long, full day out and back.
days.title: Climb the Northeast Face, descend the Southwest Couloir

schedule.label: Leave camp, cross the glacier
schedule.detail: Rope up for crevasse crossing as needed.

schedule.label: Climb the Northeast Face
schedule.detail: Mix of scrambling and low 5th class pitches to the ridge/summit.

days.objective: Summit via the face, return to camp via the SW Couloir

days.note: Reverse the approach back down North Fork Bridge Creek and the PCT to Highway 20.
days.title: Hike out
days.objective: Return to the Bridge Creek trailhead

itinerary.totalNote: A 3-day trip mirroring Goode's other northeast-side lines: long approach to a shared glacier camp, one long face-climb-and-couloir-descend day (~12 hr), then hike out; roughly 33 mi and 6,500-7,000 ft of gain round trip.
